raf_diagnostics.wall_scope: Submission/callback pacing wall statistics cover scheduler RAF only; startup/manual draws remain explicit source counters and optional rows.
raf_diagnostics.preparation_wall_scope: Active non-cancelled preparation spans only; cancelled spans retain step/count counters but have no active nominal deadline.

nominal_deadlines.scope: Nominal RAF timestamp plus supplied budget; wall-time diagnostics, not GPU, OS compositor or presentation deadlines.

before.semantics: Completed synchronous world, UI and cursor submission; repeated snapshot redraws count separately. RAF intervals use browser callback timestamps; new-snapshot RAF intervals require a globally first shown valid advancing frame. Wall/preparation/nominal-deadline diagnostics are not GPU scanout or an FPS guarantee.
